subject.title: msteams: support Copilot-only streaming without enabling Teams DM streaming

question: Should the Microsoft Teams plugin add a supported Copilot-specific streaming config path, and if so what activity metadata and config key shape should be the permanent contract?
rationale: The source limitation is clear, but the fix depends on a new user-facing config surface and a reliable Microsoft 365 Copilot custom-engine detector that is not proven by current repository evidence.

options.title: Approve detector-first per-surface config
options.body: Require a redacted live Copilot activity sample, then add plugin-owned Copilot detection plus a documented per-surface streaming config that falls back to current `channels.msteams.streaming` defaults.

options.title: Keep global-only streaming for now
options.body: Leave the current global streaming config as the only supported mode until maintainers have enough Microsoft 365 Copilot metadata proof to avoid a brittle detector.

options.title: Reject Copilot-only streaming scope
options.body: Close this direction as not planned if maintainers do not want to expand msteams streaming configuration beyond the existing global mode.

recommendation.title: Approve detector-first per-surface config
recommendation.body: Require a redacted live Copilot activity sample, then add plugin-owned Copilot detection plus a documented per-surface streaming config that falls back to current `channels.msteams.streaming` defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: BradGroux has recent adjacent msteams config work and maintains the Microsoft ecosystem tracker that already lists this request.
